description: This Java class 'NewRepoConfig' handles parsing, validation, and sanitization of repository URIs for the F-Droid app, including extracting credentials and security parameters, and managing related restrictions.

classes.name: NewRepoConfig
classes.description: Class for configuring and validating repository URIs, extracting credentials, and managing security restrictions.

methods.name: NewRepoConfig
methods.description: Constructs a new repository configuration from a URI string or Intent.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the configuration by parsing the URI, validating, and extracting parameters.

methods.name: getBssid
methods.description: Returns the BSSID parameter from the URI.

methods.name: getSsid
methods.description: Returns the SSID parameter from the URI.

methods.name: getRepoUriString
methods.description: Returns the sanitized repository URI as a string.

methods.name: getRepoUri
methods.description: Returns the repository URI as a Uri object.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username extracted from the URI.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password extracted from the URI.

methods.name: getFingerprint
methods.description: Returns the fingerprint parameter from the URI.

methods.name: isValidRepo
methods.description: Indicates if the URI is a valid repository.

methods.name: isFromSwap
methods.description: Indicates if the URI was obtained via a swap operation.

methods.name: preventFurtherSwaps
methods.description: Indicates if further swap requests should be prevented.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message if URI parsing/validation failed.

methods.name: sanitizeRepoUri
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats the repository URI, enforcing HTTPS for certain domains and normalizing the URI string.

methods.name: toPeer
methods.description: Converts the configuration into a WifiPeer object.

methods.name: hasDisallowInstallUnknownSources
methods.description: Checks if the device policy disallows installation from unknown sources.
